title: Zappers
tagline: Zappers allows you to discover and launch omnichain trading bots without writing any code
description:
Zappers allows you to discover and launch omnichain trading bots without writing any code in under 2 minutes allowing you to automate any trading strategy you might have including: 

1/ Buy Solana if it falls below 140 but sell if it goes above 160
2/ Buy any token that Trump tweets about
3/ Sell 0.01 ETH on Base for Arbitrum USDC every minute

or discover other people's trading bots where you can soon copy and invest in other people's trading bots and the creators of the trading bots can choose to add a fees to that and launch a token associated with the same.
how_its_made:
At zappers we use privy for user login and supabase for user authentication and have created zappers-backend an api that accepts private key of user, agent details and agent prompt and creates a trading strategy deployed on vercel as a serverless function that can be triggered with a websocket, a cron job that runs at certain intervals and more and does a cross chain swap based on the agent prompt when triggered. zappers also allows you to discover other people's trading bots.

We support Flow, Katana and Zircuit chains and are using graph for our data.
